🔥 Raven | Swift
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide users with a secure, on-device AI assistant for querying and summarizing personal documents on macOS and iOS.
✨ Key Features: • Text extraction from images, PDFs, audio, and video files • Audio transcription and video text extraction • Smart Q&A and contextual content analysis • Local AI processing using Apple Foundation Models • Project creation and file organization
📖 Summary: Raven is a privacy-focused AI assistant app for macOS and iOS that allows users to upload documents and ask questions. It leverages Apple's on-device Foundation Models for all processing, ensuring data remains local and no internet connection is required for its core AI features.
